title: Phase E review 2 — the session row, rebuilt to your sketch

steps.headline: Name and folder start at the same left edge; a pill on the right says what the session is doing, tag marks under it.
steps.changed: The dot left the front of the name and became a pill that says the state in words. The folder name gets a small folder mark. Tags on a session show as coloured dots below the pill, with a page mark when the session has a note; resting on them names them.
steps.measured: row 47 px, was 49; 9 rows visible; up to 4 marks per row
steps.notice: You can read what a session is doing without remembering what a colour meant, and see which sessions carry tags or a note. The DANGER mark on a bypass session stays, just left of the pill.
steps.risk: Each row carries more, so a tagged session with a long name is busier, and the 6 px tag marks are colour only until you hover them.

steps.headline: You named four states. The app has a fifth colour — amber, “may have stalled” — needing its own word or red's.

variants.label: Five words
variants.summary: Amber gets its own word, “Needs a Look”. Every colour says exactly what it means, at the cost of one word you did not ask for.
variants.risk: Five things to learn instead of four.

variants.label: Four words
variants.summary: Amber says “Needs Input”, the same as red. Only your four words ever appear, but two different colours say the same thing and one of them is a guess.
variants.risk: A stalled turn and a permission prompt read alike, so you would open the session to find out which it is.
